    SUM(line_amount) as total_revenue
FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-05-04' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY DATE(bill_ts)
ORDER BY bill_date;

    SUM(total_revenue) as total_revenue,
    SUM(num_bills) as total_bills,
    SUM(total_revenue) / SUM(num_bills) as avg_bill_value
FROM (
    SELECT 
        DATE(bill_ts) as bill_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bill_id) as num_bills,
        SUM(line_amount) as total_revenue
    FROM store.pos_lines
    WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-05-04' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
    GROUP BY DATE(bill_ts)
) sub;
